# Columns:
#  E_true_MeV   true (deposited) positron energy in MeV. The curve starts at 1.022 MeV (= 2 m_e c^2).
#  nominal      best fit (solid red line)
#  lower_1sig   lower edge of the 68% C.L. band (light red shading)
#  upper_1sig   upper edge of the 68% C.L. band
#  err_minus    nominal - lower_1sig
#  err_plus     upper_1sig - nominal
#
# Precision:
#  - The band edges are stored with 5000 points per edge (one every ~0.0022 MeV), so they are exact to the
#    PDF's precision (about 1e-5 in non-linearity).
#  - The red line is stored as a simplified 33-vertex polyline. Linear interpolation between its vertices is
#    good to about 5e-4 in non-linearity, which is why err_minus and err_plus can differ by up to ~1e-3
#    where the band is narrowest (around 1.4-1.5 MeV); the band edges themselves are exact.
#  - At 1.022 MeV the band edges join the curve with a vertical segment; the band there is taken from that
#    segment's end points.
#  - The band continues up to 12 MeV in the PDF (clipped by the axis frame at 10 MeV), while the red line
#    stops at 10 MeV, so the table ends at 10 MeV.
# generated by claude opus 5.5
